description: A script to delete all knowledge entries from Devin's Knowledge API with interactive confirmation and API calls.

classes.name: ApiKnowledgeEntry
classes.description: Interface representing a knowledge entry with id and name.

classes.name: ApiListResponse
classes.description: Interface representing the API response containing folders and knowledge entries.

methods.name: apiRequest
methods.description: Performs an API request with specified method and endpoint, returning parsed JSON.

methods.name: listKnowledge
methods.description: Fetches the list of knowledge entries from the API.

methods.name: deleteKnowledge
methods.description: Deletes a knowledge entry by its ID.

methods.name: askConfirmation
methods.description: Prompts the user for a yes/no confirmation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating the fetching, confirmation, and deletion of knowledge entries.
